title: OpenAI Boosts GPT-6 Astra and 6.1 Sol Speeds by 50%
summary:
OpenCode and Devin are now benefiting from an optimization that reduces the time needed to generate tokens for high end models. OpenAI has increased inference speeds for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol by approximately 50%, lifting throughput from 30 tokens per second to 50 tokens per second. The update applies to all subscribers and partners using Sign in with ChatGPT, including Pi and Amp, and rolls out over a few hours without requiring user configuration.

This speed increase is the first entry in a 28 day shipping sprint in which OpenAI will release either a functional improvement or a full system reset every day. The initiative follows DevDay and focuses on increasing efficiency and simplification for Codex and other work tools, with internal resources prioritized for the company's developer and corporate user base.

Day 1/

We have optimized the default speed to be ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol through the subscription across all our products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT (including OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, ...).

No changes needed on your end and this should be felt within the next two hours.
